raw_segments.text: Then dialectic, and dialectic alone, goes directly to the first principle, and is the
only science which does away with hypotheses in order to make her ground secure.
The eye of the soul, which is literally buried in an outlandish slew, is by her gentle aid
lifted upwards, and she uses as handmaids and helpers in the work of conversion, the
sciences which we have been discussing.
Custom terms them sciences, but they ought to have some other name, implying greater
clearness than opinion and less clearness than science.
And this, in our previous sketch, was called understanding.
But why should we dispute about names when we have realities of such importance to consider?
